basic_info.description: Luxury 1-br at The Harrison, San Francisco's iconic full-service luxury high rise. Top-end luxury finishes include Oak plank flooring, a sleek & modern chef's kitchen with premium cabinetry by Studio Becker, Marble counters, timeless brass fixtures by Waterworks, Bertazzoni appliances, Sub Zero refrigerator. Turn-key condo comes with 1-car Valet parking, private storage unit, private wine locker in temp controlled room. 5 Star Amenities include onsite Lifestyle Concierge, 24hr valet, fitness center w/steam room, outdoor pool, spa, & the sensational Uncle Harry's 49th floor owner's lounge with bar, dining room, parlor, speakeasy lounge & incomparable Bay Bridge & skyline views, Enjoy convenient access to South Beach's top restaurants, local shops, bars & close to major freeways.  4E has it all! Harrison is more than a building; it's an iconic living experience in San Francisco, offering ultimate luxury, sophisticated amenities, and an unparalleled lifestyle. Whether you're attracted to the A+ location, the world-class amenities, or the thoughtfully designed interiors, The Harrison brings an elevated living experience to the heart of South Beach.
